body:
- `app/src/modules/demands/http/routes.tsx:219-224` and `app/src/modules/demands/infrastructure/items.ts` load up to `100000` rows into memory before slicing for pagination; no SQL `LIMIT/OFFSET`/keyset is applied at the DB layer.
- `app/src/modules/demands/infrastructure/items.ts` `counts()` also calls `items(... limit: 100000)` just to count Q1 in JS, and `MyPage` filters the full 100k result set in memory (`app/src/modules/demands/views/demands.tsx`).
- `app/src/layout/views/layout.tsx:46` loads `htmx.min.js` (36KB) globally, but only one view uses `hx-*` (`app/src/layout/views/chat.tsx:37-39`); HTMX is effectively unused on most routes.
- `app/src/app.tsx:37` serves `/static/*` via `serveStatic` without `Cache-Control`/`ETag`, so ADR-008’s expected `public, max-age=3600` for assets is not actually emitted; only the service worker caches them.
- `app/static/sw.js` precaches a hardcoded asset list and misses `whiteboard-config.js`; its cache-first strategy plus fixed `VERSION` can serve stale assets after deploy until the version is bumped.
- `app/src/modules/attachments/http/routes.tsx:96-97` serves original image bytes with only 1h cache; there are no thumbnails/variants even though ADR-031 specifies AVIF/WebP variants, and no `media` module exists in `app/src`.
- `app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css` and `app/static/css/app.css` are duplicated manually, and `app/deno.json` has no `css:build`/`js:build` tasks, so asset drift is likely (ADR-029 not reflected in tasks).
- `app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css:151` caps `.main` at `max-width: 1280px` and the largest responsive breakpoint is 1100px, so full-HD (1920px) screens leave large unused margins.
- `app/src/modules/conversations/views/chat.tsx:58-62` reloads the whole page to load older messages, despite the unused `/chat/channels/:id/messages` fragment endpoint in `app/src/modules/conversations/http/routes.tsx:129`.
- `app/src/static/js/app.js` is a single 10KB hand-bundled script with no route-based splitting; canvas/Excalidraw is isolated via iframe, but chat SSE and markdown preview logic always ship to every page.
